content: The enduring impact of historic mining practices, coupled with slow policy reforms, underscores the significant hurdles the nation faces in stabilizing its mining sector [74] . Ensuring sustainable land use and environmental restoration across the country demands an integrated asset management strategy that rigorously accounts for environmental degradation, navigates complex regulatory compliance costs, and remains resilient in the face of unpredictable market fluctuations.
